headlines.text: Back on this day in 2023, it was Gringo Loco's first night in AEW, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.69.

Back on this day in 2021, The Good Brothers vs. The Young Bucks vs. Jurassic Express vs. The Lucha Brothers vs. Doc Gallows vs. Karl Anderson vs. Matt Jackson vs. Nick Jackson vs. Jungle Boy vs. Luchasaurus vs. Rey Fenix vs. Penta El Zero M headlined Dynamite, rated 6.88.
Rewind to 2023, when Vincent laced up for their first AEW match in a Battle Royal match, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.08.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2023, Skye Blue vs. Willow Nightingale vs. Anna Jay vs. Taya Valkyrie headlined Rampage, rated 6.01.
Rewind to 2021, when Tay Conti vs. Penelope Ford crossed paths for the first time ever on Dynamite, rated 5.33.
Rewind to 2021, when it marked the first-ever meeting between Orange Cassidy and Jack Evans on Dynamite, rated 4.19.
